title: Answer what calls a method where text search gets the receiver wrong
prompt: Do not change any file except the answer. In the Billing module, find every call of ILedger.Record(string account, decimal amount), the method of the ILedger interface. Other types have a Record method with the same name and parameters (for example IAuditTrail.Record); those calls do not count. A call counts when it runs ILedger.Record, whatever the call site names its receiver. Write the answer to T5-answer.txt in the root of this folder, one call per line as path:line, with the path relative to the root, forward slashes and a one-based line number, and nothing else.

checks.name: the answer lists exactly the calls
